lessons.title: How a Request Travels
lessons.scope: One page load hop by hop: DNS, TCP/TLS handshake, request, server + DB, response, extra assets; where time goes.

lessons.title: Latency & Throughput
lessons.scope: Latency vs throughput vs bandwidth, percentiles (p50/p99), tail latency, Little's Law.

lessons.title: Napkin Math
lessons.scope: Back-of-envelope estimation: QPS from DAU, storage growth, bandwidth, latency numbers every engineer should know, powers of two.

lessons.title: DNS in Depth
lessons.scope: Recursive vs authoritative resolvers, root/TLD, record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT), TTL and caching, GeoDNS and DNS-based failover.

lessons.title: HTTP, TLS & Connections
lessons.scope: HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 multiplexing vs HTTP/3 (QUIC), keep-alive and connection pooling, TLS 1.3 handshake, head-of-line blocking.

lessons.title: High-Level vs Low-Level Design
lessons.scope: How a design interview/process flows: requirements, estimates, HLD boxes, API, data model, LLD of a component, trade-offs.

lessons.title: Vertical vs Horizontal Scaling
lessons.scope: Scale up vs scale out, limits of each, cost curves, when a bigger box is the right answer.

lessons.title: Stateless Services
lessons.scope: Moving session state out of servers (tokens, shared session store), why statelessness enables scaling and failover; sticky sessions trade-off.

lessons.title: Load Balancing
lessons.scope: L4 vs L7, algorithms (round robin, least connections, consistent hash), health checks, LB redundancy.

lessons.title: Autoscaling
lessons.scope: Reactive vs scheduled vs predictive scaling, metrics to scale on, warm-up/cooldown, scaling lag and over-provisioning.

lessons.title: CDNs & Edge
lessons.scope: Edge caching of static and dynamic content, origin shield, cache keys, purge, push vs pull CDN, edge compute.

lessons.title: Proxies & API Gateways
lessons.scope: Forward vs reverse proxy, API gateway responsibilities (auth, routing, rate limits, aggregation), BFF pattern, gateway as SPOF.

lessons.title: Caching Basics
lessons.scope: Cache-aside, read-through, write-through, write-back, write-around; hit ratio; eviction (LRU/LFU); where caches live.

lessons.title: Cache Invalidation & Stampedes
lessons.scope: TTL vs explicit invalidation, stale reads, thundering herd / cache stampede, request coalescing, probabilistic early expiry, hot keys.

lessons.title: Bloom Filters & Sketches
lessons.scope: Bloom filter mechanics and false positives, use to avoid disk/cache misses, Count-Min sketch and HyperLogLog for counting at scale.

lessons.title: SQL vs NoSQL
lessons.scope: Relational vs key-value, document, wide-column, graph; schema, joins, query patterns; choosing by access pattern.

lessons.title: Indexes
lessons.scope: B-tree indexes, composite index column order, covering indexes, write cost of indexes, full scans vs index seeks.

lessons.title: Storage Engines: B-Trees vs LSM
lessons.scope: B-tree page updates vs LSM memtable/SSTables/compaction, write vs read amplification, WAL.

lessons.title: Transactions & Isolation
lessons.scope: ACID, isolation levels, anomalies (dirty read, lost update, write skew), MVCC, locking.

lessons.title: Replication
lessons.scope: Leader-follower, sync vs async, replication lag and read-your-writes, multi-leader and leaderless, failover.

lessons.title: Sharding
lessons.scope: Range vs hash partitioning, choosing a shard key, hot partitions, cross-shard queries, resharding.

lessons.title: Consistent Hashing
lessons.scope: Hash ring, minimal key movement on node add/remove, virtual nodes, use in caches and Dynamo-style stores.

lessons.title: Files & Object Storage
lessons.scope: Block vs file vs object storage, blobs in S3-like stores, metadata DB + blob pattern, presigned URLs, multipart upload.

lessons.title: Search & Inverted Indexes
lessons.scope: Tokenization, inverted index, ranking (TF-IDF/BM25 idea), sharded search clusters, syncing from primary DB.

lessons.title: Geospatial Indexing
lessons.scope: Proximity search problem, geohash, quadtrees, S2/H3 cells idea, nearby-driver style queries.

lessons.title: Time-Series Data
lessons.scope: Append-heavy timestamped data, downsampling/rollups, retention, time-partitioned storage, metrics use case.

lessons.title: OLTP vs OLAP & Warehouses
lessons.scope: Row vs column storage, ETL/ELT, data warehouse vs data lake, why analytics queries kill an OLTP DB.

lessons.title: CAP & PACELC
lessons.scope: Partitions force choosing consistency or availability; PACELC latency vs consistency; consistency models (strong, eventual, causal).

lessons.title: Quorums (N, R, W)
lessons.scope: Leaderless replication, R + W > N, sloppy quorum and hinted handoff, read repair, anti-entropy.

lessons.title: Consensus (Raft)
lessons.scope: Why consensus, Raft leader election, log replication, majority commit, terms; what etcd/ZooKeeper are used for.

lessons.title: Leader Election & Distributed Locks
lessons.scope: Leases, lock services, fencing tokens, why a lock with only a TTL is unsafe under GC pauses.

lessons.title: Clocks & Ordering
lessons.scope: Clock skew, NTP, Lamport timestamps, vector clocks, happens-before, hybrid logical clocks; why last-write-wins loses data.

lessons.title: Gossip & Failure Detection
lessons.scope: Heartbeats, timeouts vs phi-accrual detectors, gossip dissemination and membership, split brain.

lessons.title: Conflict Resolution & CRDTs
lessons.scope: Concurrent writes in multi-leader/offline systems, LWW vs merge, G-counter, OR-set, collaborative editing idea.

lessons.title: Unique ID Generation
lessons.scope: Auto-increment limits, UUIDv4 vs v7, Snowflake-style IDs (time + machine + sequence), ticket servers, sortability.

lessons.title: API Styles: REST, RPC, GraphQL
lessons.scope: REST resources, gRPC/protobuf, GraphQL; pagination, versioning, choosing a style.

lessons.title: Real-Time: Polling, SSE, WebSockets
lessons.scope: Short vs long polling, Server-Sent Events, WebSockets, connection fan-out and stateful gateways.

lessons.title: Message Queues
lessons.scope: Producers/consumers, decoupling and buffering, at-least-once delivery, acks, visibility timeout, dead-letter queues.

lessons.title: Pub/Sub & Event Logs
lessons.scope: Topics, fan-out, partitioned logs (Kafka-style), consumer groups and offsets, ordering per partition, retention/replay.

lessons.title: Batch vs Stream Processing
lessons.scope: MapReduce-style batch, stream processing, windows, late events, lambda vs kappa architecture.

lessons.title: Event Sourcing & CQRS
lessons.scope: Storing events not state, rebuilding projections, separate read/write models, eventual consistency of read side, snapshots.

lessons.title: Service Discovery
lessons.scope: Client-side vs server-side discovery, registries, health-based registration, DNS-based discovery.

lessons.title: Outbox Pattern & CDC
lessons.scope: The dual-write problem, transactional outbox, change data capture from the DB log, keeping caches/search in sync.

lessons.title: Redundancy & Failover
lessons.scope: SPOFs, active-active vs active-passive, availability math (nines, serial vs parallel), failover.

lessons.title: Timeouts & Retries
lessons.scope: Setting timeouts, retries with exponential backoff and jitter, retry storms, retry budgets.

lessons.title: Idempotency & Exactly-Once
lessons.scope: Idempotency keys, dedup tables, why exactly-once delivery is really at-least-once + idempotent processing.

lessons.title: Circuit Breakers & Bulkheads
lessons.scope: Closed/open/half-open states, failing fast, bulkhead isolation of pools, graceful degradation and fallbacks.

lessons.title: Backpressure & Load Shedding
lessons.scope: Queues growing unbounded, bounded queues, shedding low-priority work, admission control, adaptive concurrency.

lessons.title: Rate Limiting
lessons.scope: Token bucket, leaky bucket, fixed vs sliding window, distributed counters in Redis, where to enforce.

lessons.title: Multi-Region & Disaster Recovery
lessons.scope: RPO/RTO, backups vs replicas, active-passive vs active-active regions, data residency, failover drills.

lessons.title: Chaos Engineering & SLOs
lessons.scope: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, game days, injecting failure safely, blast radius.

lessons.title: Monolith vs Microservices
lessons.scope: Modular monolith, service boundaries, data ownership per service, costs of distribution.

lessons.title: Sagas & Distributed Transactions
lessons.scope: Why 2PC is avoided, orchestration vs choreography sagas, compensating actions.

lessons.title: Sidecars & Service Mesh
lessons.scope: Sidecar proxies, mTLS, retries/timeouts in the mesh, control plane vs data plane, overhead.

lessons.title: Serverless & Containers
lessons.scope: Containers and orchestrators (Kubernetes-style scheduling), functions-as-a-service, cold starts, when each fits.

lessons.title: Authentication
lessons.scope: Passwords + hashing, sessions vs JWTs, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC login flow, MFA, token refresh.

lessons.title: Authorization
lessons.scope: RBAC vs ABAC vs ReBAC, centralized policy checks, least privilege, multi-tenant isolation.

lessons.title: Encryption in Transit & at Rest
lessons.scope: TLS, symmetric vs asymmetric, envelope encryption with KMS, key rotation, hashing vs encryption.

lessons.title: DDoS & Abuse Protection
lessons.scope: Volumetric vs application-layer attacks, anycast and scrubbing, WAF, bot detection, per-client limits.

lessons.title: Secrets Management
lessons.scope: Why not in code/env files, vaults, short-lived credentials, rotation, workload identity.

lessons.title: Testing Distributed Systems
lessons.scope: Test pyramid, contract tests, integration with real dependencies, load tests, fault injection in tests.

lessons.title: CI/CD Pipelines
lessons.scope: Build, test, artifact, deploy stages; trunk-based development; pipeline as code; rollback.

lessons.title: Deploys: Canary, Blue-Green, Flags
lessons.scope: Rolling vs blue-green vs canary, feature flags, dark launches, schema migrations with expand/contract.

lessons.title: Observability
lessons.scope: Metrics, logs, traces; RED/USE methods; distributed tracing with trace IDs; alerting on symptoms.

lessons.title: Design a URL Shortener
lessons.scope: Write/read paths, key generation, redirect caching, analytics counting, scale numbers.

lessons.title: Design a Chat App
lessons.scope: WebSocket gateways, message storage, delivery/read receipts, presence, group fan-out, offline sync.

lessons.title: Design a News Feed
lessons.scope: Fan-out on write vs read, celebrity problem hybrid, feed cache, ranking stage.

lessons.title: Design Search Autocomplete
lessons.scope: Trie / prefix index, top-k per prefix precomputation, update pipeline, edge caching, latency budget.

lessons.title: Design a Notification System
lessons.scope: Multi-channel (push, email, SMS), preference service, queues per channel, retries, dedup, rate limits.

lessons.title: Design Video Streaming
lessons.scope: Upload, transcoding pipeline, adaptive bitrate (HLS/DASH segments), CDN delivery, metadata service.

lessons.title: Design Ride Sharing
lessons.scope: Driver location ingest, geospatial index for nearby drivers, matching, trip state machine, surge.

lessons.title: Design a Web Crawler
lessons.scope: URL frontier, politeness per host, dedup of URLs and content, DNS caching, distributed workers.

lessons.title: Design a Key-Value Store
lessons.scope: Dynamo-style: consistent hashing, replication, quorums, vector clocks/conflicts, gossip, hinted handoff.

lessons.title: Design a Payment System
lessons.scope: Idempotent payment API, ledger with double-entry, PSP integration, reconciliation, exactly-once money movement.

lessons.title: Design File Sync (Dropbox-like)
lessons.scope: Chunking and dedup, metadata vs block storage, sync notifications, conflict handling, delta sync.

lessons.title: Design Ticket Booking
lessons.scope: Seat inventory contention, temporary holds with expiry, virtual waiting room, avoiding double booking.
